unique_cell_rule: one observed three-gateway reference plus four expansion sizes times three architectures times two eligibility rules
semi_synthetic_template: componentwise median of the three observed gateway activity scales, maritime lags, and waiting-error scales

capacity_rules.capacity_neutral: renormalise observed and median-template gateway weights to the fixed observed three-gateway stage total; retain the observed shared-corridor total
capacity_rules.port_only: retain observed gateway stages, add one median-template berth-yard-gate chain per new gateway, and retain the observed shared-corridor total
capacity_rules.end_to_end: retain observed gateway stages and add one median-template berth-yard-gate chain and one median-template corridor-capacity contribution per new gateway
capacity_rules.end_to_end_reference_capacity: minimum of berth, yard, gate, and the gateway's gate-capacity-proportional share of the common corridor

eligibility_contract.emergency_only: new semi-synthetic routes are adaptive-only; committed shares on observed routes remain the official anchors
eligibility_contract.precontracted: new routes enter the commitment set using their end-to-end reference-capacity share; observed routes retain official-anchor relative proportions
eligibility_contract.reference_loading: the same predetermined end-to-end-capacity shares are used for public-signal reference loading in both eligibility cases; realised SUE shares are never used

training_contract.per_gateway_count_reference_cell: capacity_neutral and emergency_only, with the three-gateway observed reference used at n=3
training_contract.teacher: regenerate formal MPC teacher data for every gateway count
training_contract.learning: train BC and full constrained SAC from scratch for every gateway count and each of three seeds
training_contract.validation: select checkpoints on frozen validation paths and validate the BC-SAC selector
training_contract.transfer: within a gateway count, freeze the size-specific actor weights across architectures and eligibility rules; the target-cell formal projector and physical model remain active

policy_design.anchor_rule: the observed three-gateway reference and all six nine-gateway architecture-by-eligibility endpoints
policy_design.not_evaluated_rule: MPC and model-guided SAC outside the seven anchors are NOT_EVALUATED_BY_DESIGN and are never imputed
policy_design.interpretation: architecture component values are primary under fixed Passive, Reactive, and size-specific BC mappings; five-policy regret is reported only at anchors

path_design.selection_rule: select the largest preregistered count in [16,44] supported by the validation-path computational gate and the remaining runtime budget; observed test outcomes never select N
